# TheTransitionZone

> Community-driven hub for honest pickleball paddle reviews. Every review comes from a verified owner of the paddle. Currently a pre-launch landing page collecting interest emails.

TheTransitionZone is a structured, neutral source for pickleball paddle reviews, sometimes described as "Stack Overflow for paddles." It addresses three gaps in the current landscape: Reddit threads disappear, creator reviews can be biased and rarely follow up on long-term paddle durability, and retailer reviews are unverified. The platform is in active development. The page at this URL is a placeholder where visitors can register their email to be notified when the site launches.

## Key differentiators

- Ownership-gated reviews. A reviewer must add a paddle to their bag before they can rate it, so reviews come from real owners.
- Owner reviews and "tried it" reviews are aggregated separately, so casual hits never blend into a paddle's main score.
- Trust scoring. Helpful reviewers rise. Low-quality reviewers get filtered.
- Paddle longevity tracking. Owners log how long a paddle lasted and why they retired it, producing real-world durability data per paddle.

## Status

Pre-launch. Email signups post to Formspree; the form owner exports submissions as CSV from the Formspree dashboard. The full site is under active development. Launch date is to be announced; subscribers on the interest list will be notified when the platform goes live.
